doc: Which method makes the voice for each emotion. A = neutral reference + v4 tag + PSOLA; B = emotional reference of the same speaker; C = B + mild PSOLA. Evidence: session1.csv, session2.csv, round 3 (2026-11-15, 64 clips, 7-way choice, one listener).

pending.happy: C heard as happy 4/8 (B 3/8; earlier A 0.07, B 0.10-0.25): best so far, still weak; single listener
pending.fear/disgust/surprise: A heard correctly 1/8, 0/8, 1/8 (surprise heard as happy 5/8): not conveyed, so spoken neutrally (N) instead of a wrong emotion

overrides_doc: Removed 2026-11-15: round 3 f005 angry B heard angry 2/2, f004 happy B/C 1/2 each; A is worse for those. Crackle notes (items 19, 24, 32, 41, 51) are all B/C of angry/happy: the guard retries/falls back; re-check after tts.py clip fix.

guard.doc: retry with another seed when the clip has clipped samples, non-finite values, is near-silent, or is far shorter / longer than the text predicts; then fall back B/C -> A -> N
